src/math/ninja_length.hpp.reason: Complete semantic math module independently reviewed against exact arithmetic contracts.
src/math/ninja_length.hpp.semantic_justification: Complete typed vector-length API and implementation are reviewed. A single named CPU fidelity operation now serves both the ExactFloat math wrapper and retained raw legacy rotation wrapper. It preserves interleaved x/y/z loads/squares, (zz+yy)+xx, binary32 squared spill, signed-root operations and unrounded ext80 return. The math module owns no persistent state, fixture availability, guest transport, executable access or dispatch.

resolved_owners.resolution: Caller owns its live numeric context and vector. The shared pure CPU compatibility primitive owns no state and exposes only this specific retained result, not a generic raw getter. Legacy player wrapper remains debt outside this closed math module.

resolved_consumers.resolution: Actual rotation, position/contact, acceleration variants, direction/reset/reaction, mesh/scene/broadphase and Sonic/Gamma source closures inspected under seventeen configurations. Source/link reach is distinguished from actual entry hits. Both public return contracts are unchanged.
